steps.title: Inspect and Audit Startup Crash Suspects
steps.description: Analyze project resources, style files, and database connections to identify the source of the crash on app open.

steps.title: Optimize Database Connection Lifecycle
steps.description: Remove premature manual db.close() calls in DatabaseHelper write operations to prevent SQLiteException connection state crashes.

steps.title: Refactor Theme and Window Settings
steps.description: Update AppTheme in styles.xml to use a reliable system-level Material Light theme with explicit titlebar disabling to prevent action bar inflation crashes.

steps.title: Clean build.gradle Dependencies
steps.description: Remove external NanoHTTPD dependency to maintain full SDK compatibility and ensure strict alignment with built-in native SDK packages.

steps.title: Validate Main Activity Handler
steps.description: Ensure Main Thread Looper is correctly bound to avoid execution errors on modern target Android version runtimes.

steps.title: Inspect Layout Inflation Bindings
steps.description: Verify custom view reference inside analytics layout and main relative structures.

steps.title: Validate AndroidManifest Configuration
steps.description: Check namespace resolution and application entry configurations inside the main manifest.

steps.title: Verify SharedPreferences Initialization
steps.description: Confirm safety of administrative preference loaders inside Settings activity flow.

steps.title: Confirm App Metadata Package Details
steps.description: Verify metadata file coordinates accurately correspond to the build system target.

steps.title: Building OmniControl Suite
steps.description: Compile entire suite with optimized parameters and run debug check tasks.
